claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Epic Boon is a permanent character-sheet acquisition with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset. The existing 'activation' family requires all three. A new family (e.g. 'passive_grant' or 'level_grant') is needed for features that are simply owned at level-up with no trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect of Epic Boon is acquiring a feat of the player's choice from the Epic Boon category. No ClassFeatureEffect variant covers this. The v4 taxonomy has grant_proficiency and grant_spell_access but no grant_feat atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: open_choice constraint on grant_feat
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feat is not a fixed selection — the player chooses from the Epic Boon feat category (or any feat they qualify for). This is an open-choice picker pattern that the current surface has no way to encode for feat grants. The surface would need a way to express 'one feat from category X' or 'any qualifying feat'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Combat Prowess is recommended.
